messages:
devon-peopleops: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: collecting all travel/desk/offsite questions here. I'll answer what I can and tag owners for the rest. @anna-peopleops @mike-cto please chime in.
anna-peopleops: thanks! I'll add links and a short checklist. For anything finance-related I'll loop in the team.
lee-eng: booking tool Q 12 is Concur still primary? Heard about an Expensify pilot.
mike-cto: short: Expensify for receipts and per-diem submissions, Concur remains for corporate-card reconciliation. Expensify rollout starts next quarter; until then either is fine if you tag project codes.
yasmin-ops: desk holds for offsite weeks 12 can we reserve ahead of time?
anna-peopleops: yes 12 offsite desk-hold window opens 10 days before the event. One hold per person per offsite; expires at midnight on last event day. Use the workspace app and mark the hold type "offsite".
devon-peopleops: hold flow: https://workplace.internal/desk-holds (internal link). Remember to include the offsite tag so finance can map costs.
travel-bot: Notice: expense policy v2 available at https://docs/redwood/finance/expense-policy-v2
lee-eng: reimbursement timing if I pay hotel personally?
anna-peopleops: finance aims for 7 business days after a complete submission. Corporate card auto-match is faster. If >10 business days, escalate to finance@redwood.com.
lee-eng: meals on travel days 12 arrival/departure covered?
mike-cto: covers full travel days. Partial days allow reasonable meals within per-diem. If special case, ask manager and tag for approval.
devon-peopleops: handy expense tag example to paste into submission: project: offsite-<hub>-<year>; reason: team-offsite; cost-center: <team-code>.
anna-peopleops: guest policy: guests allowed at approved offsites with manager sign-off and RSVP list. For day-to-day hub guests: manager approval + badge request 72h in advance.
yasmin-ops: travel blackout windows or fare guidance?
mike-cto: no strict blackout. Use flexible fares for mission-critical trips where cancellations likely. Sales/ops teams may have separate flows; contact your ops lead.
lee-eng: devs returning from travel sometimes need a desk for a couple days 12 can we reserve short-term?
anna-peopleops: yes 12 48-hour post-travel grace hold available in the workspace app under "post-travel grace". Not for permanent desks.
devon-peopleops: leads: please add rough travel headcount to project plans so finance can pre-allocate budgets.
travel-bot: Tip: upload PDFs for receipts when possible to speed approvals.
yasmin-ops: vaccine/test requirements changed?
mike-cto: no company-wide changes. Follow local venue or country requirements; event owners must publish any extra rules on RSVP.
anna-peopleops: offsite owner checklist (short): 1) submit travel estimate 30 days prior, 2) create desk holds 10 days prior, 3) publish local health/venue rules, 4) collect guest approvals 7 days prior. I'll share a template.
devon-peopleops: if you have edge cases (visa reimbursements, long-term remote needing temporary desk for project weeks), drop them here and we'll route.
lee-eng: transit stipend for hubs?
anna-peopleops: some hubs offer commute stipends for offsite days up to $15/day; check the HR portal stipend tab.
devon-peopleops: thanks all. I'll write a concise FAQ + checklist and post by EOD. Please DM me if you need immediate help. :thumbsup:
mike-cto: thanks 12 if travel-heavy teams need roadmap impact conversation, ping me and we'll sync.
